name: secdeva/fieldTypes/assetCriticalityRequirement

enumValues.enumDescription: Setting the criticality of an asset is not required
The overall criticality is required for each asset. It can also be derived from the criticality of confidentiality, integrity, availability or health, safety and the environment
The criticality of confidentiality, integrity, availability and health, safety and the environment is required for each asset, in addition to the overall criticality

description: Defines which criticality fields are required for the assets of a development project
